{{Top|leg}}
'''Skin buster''' was the name given by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to a [[Color/Legends|red]] goo developed by the [[Orgon]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gorsh]] which they spread around the encampments of [[Genetech Laboratories]] [[Scientist/Legends|science]] encampments. It was a sticky substance filled with an irritant sap that, when exposed directly to the skin, causing a screaming insane [[Death/Legends|death]] within [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] unless the victim was provided with appropriate medical attention.
